roles.agentswitchboard: Windows/WSL bootstrap convergence, readiness, validation, evidence, and escalation
roles.firstmate: canonical live crew runtime after the bridge floor is proven

routing.reason: The bridge validates the runtime substrate and hands off. It does not select or supervise the FirstMate crew.

guardrails: Native-Windows FirstMate execution is out of scope; Windows is a bridge host only.
Every WSL call uses explicit Ubuntu and a bounded timeout.
PowerShell-to-Bash commands are normalized to LF before transport.
Windows paths cross into WSL only through WSLENV /p; wslpath is not a dependency.
Linux Git never consumes a Windows linked-worktree .git indirection; the bridge creates a WSL-owned standalone exact-head clone.
Empty stdout/stderr are valid native-process results and must not fail parameter binding.
The prerequisite gate observes git, gh, tmux, python3, and GitHub authentication but does not install tools or mutate credentials.
Evidence roots are unique per attempt and remain local/untracked.
No AgentSwitchboard child-bus adapter, dispatch selector, wake loop, supervisor, or FirstMate crew-control skill is introduced by this harness.
proof_ceiling: Tracked bridge/harness structure, explicit-Ubuntu and bounded-process contracts, local evidence routing, Windows-native contract front door, prerequisite-gate behavior, and hosted Windows/Linux validation only. Physical WSL/Ubuntu execution and live/productive FirstMate crew runtime remain unproved until FM-WSL-12 and FM-CREW-13.
